settings.heading: Care starts with the details.
settings.intro: Different materials and products need different care.

settings.title: Follow the product guidance.
settings.body: Read the instructions supplied with the specific product. Care needs vary across clothing, accessories, home goods and electronics.

settings.title: Choose a gentle approach.
settings.body: Check material and cleaning information before using a treatment. For powered products, follow the manufacturer’s safety and maintenance instructions.

settings.title: Ask about your item.
settings.body: Send a product question and include its name.
